actions.name: Operational Dependency Mapping
actions.description: Operational dependency mapping identifies and models the dependencies of the organization's activities on each other and on the organization's performers (people, systems, and services.)  This may include modeling the higher- and lower-level activities of an organization forming a hierarchy, or layering, of the dependencies in an organization's activities.
actions.reason: Operational Dependency Mapping helps identify dependencies between systems and services, ensuring acquisition policies account for organizational interdependencies.

actions.name: Principle of least privilege
actions.description: Implement robust access control mechanisms, enforce the principle of least privilege, and regularly update and patch systems to close security gaps that could be exploited for privilege escalation.
actions.reason: Principle of least privilege ensures access controls are implemented during acquisitions, directly supporting security policy development.

actions.name: System Mapping
actions.description: System mapping encompasses the techniques to identify the organization's systems, how they are configured and decomposed into subsystems and components, how they are dependent on one another, and where they are physically located.
actions.reason: System Mapping provides visibility into existing systems and components, enabling structured policies for acquiring and integrating new systems.

actions.name: System Vulnerability Assessment
actions.description: System vulnerability assessment relates all the vulnerabilities of a system's components in the context of their configuration and internal dependencies and can also include assessing risk emerging from the system's design as a whole, not just the sum of individual component vulnerabilities.
actions.reason: Evaluates system vulnerabilities and design risks, directly informing resource requirements for mitigation.

actions.name: Network Vulnerability Assessment
actions.description: Network vulnerability assessment relates all the vulnerabilities of a network's components in the context of their configuration and interdependencies and can also include assessing risk emerging from the network's design as a whole, not just the sum of individual network node or network segment vulnerabilities.
actions.reason: Evaluates network vulnerabilities and design risks, directly informing resource requirements for mitigation.

subgoals.embedding_context: Include security and privacy requirements in acquisition contracts and related documents

actions.name: Access Policy Administration
actions.description: Access policy administration is the systematic process of defining, implementing, and managing access control policies that dictate user permissions to resources.
actions.reason: Access Policy Administration directly supports defining and managing access control policies that must be explicitly included in contracts to enforce security and privacy requirements.

actions.name: Access Mediation
actions.description: Access mediation is the process of granting or denying specific requests to: 1) obtain and use information and related information processing services; and 2) enter specific physical facilities (e.g., Federal buildings, military establishments, border crossing entrances). Access mediation decisions should enforce least privilege by granting access for scoped durations to prevent privilege creep and, where applicable, implement just-in-time (JIT) access. Denial decisions may prevent initial access or terminate access that has already been granted, ensuring continuous enforcement of security policies.
actions.reason: Access Mediation ensures least-privilege enforcement and JIT access controls, which are critical security requirements to include in contracts to prevent privilege escalation and unauthorized access.

actions.name: Data Access Control
actions.description: Limit external data source access.
actions.reason: Data Access Control mitigations directly address limiting external data source access, a core privacy requirement that must be explicitly defined in acquisition contracts.

actions.name: User Group Permissions
actions.description: Access control where access is determined based on attributes associated with users and the objects being accessed.
actions.reason: User Group Permissions enforce attribute-based access controls, ensuring contractual requirements for role-specific data handling and privacy protections are operationalized.

actions.name: Network Resource Access Mediation
actions.description: Control of access to organizational systems and services by users or processes over a network.
actions.reason: Network Resource Access Mediation controls access to organizational systems over networks, a key security requirement that must be explicitly specified in contracts.
